title: Apply the cost-chain rule to the J2 improvement claim
prompt: The research-kb server may be unreachable in this environment; if so, record that under 'Sources checked' and use the repository's own files. Every number you report is an unverified assertion unless a pcc claim says otherwise; tag it. Apply AGENTS.md section 3a to the J2 claim (`c_D = 1.60` against the frozen `2.00`, N4v2 DL1) as validated in `research/leads_followup_20261114/item03_j2_validation/`. Write `$T_OUT/cost-chain-j2.md`: the chain from the incumbent to the candidate in the counted unit, each line labelled RESTRUCTURE or REPLACE, the section 3 class (advance, engineering, relabelling or accounting) with the reason, the section 5a band at 0, 0.1 and 1 per native operation as far as the evidence allows, and the distance remaining to the matched rho if the evidence gives it. Do not edit the study. The harness sets T_OUT (an output directory outside git); write every report file there.
acceptance: $T_OUT/cost-chain-j2.md has lines beginning RESTRUCTURE and REPLACE
contains exactly one of the class words advance, engineering, relabelling, accounting, in a line starting 'Class:'
carries [pcc:unverified], passes lint-prose and has a 'Sources checked' line
check_command: F="$T_OUT/cost-chain-j2.md"; grep -q '^RESTRUCTURE' "$F" && grep -q '^REPLACE' "$F" && [ "$(grep -cE '^Class: *(advance|engineering|relabelling|accounting)\b' "$F")" = 1 ] && grep -q '1\.60' "$F" && grep -q '2\.00' "$F" && grep -q '0\.1' "$F" && grep -q 'pcc:unverified' "$F" && grep -qi 'sources checked' "$F" && python3 tools/pcc/pcc.py lint-prose "$F" && git diff --quiet "$T_BASE" HEAD -- research/leads_followup_20261114
forbidden: editing a file whose SHA-256 a tracked manifest pins (frozen evidence) to make a check pass
disabling, skipping, deleting or weakening a test or check to make it pass
editing the checking tool or its allow-list so that it passes
citing a result as verified without a pcc claim id (use [pcc:unverified])
editing the study or evidence you are checking
inventing a source id, claim id or number
a RESTRUCTURE line that changes the total
a line that both restructures and replaces
notes: Format gate only. The class and the chain are judged by the blinded validator: the committed validation says the gain exists in the unit that leaves additions unpriced and the disposition is insufficient_evidence.
